decisionSummary: Selected the current Teleport dev-publish v1.3.4/version-10 source after a complete remote-head inventory. The Aug 14 session-teardown line is an ancestor of this source, which also contains later release binding, dependency lock, and fail-closed shell-permission work. The divergent publish line is the historical v1.0.0 delivery branch, retained as evidence rather than release input.

checks: clean exact checkout at the selected commit
origin dev-publish and main both advertise the selected commit
all advertised remote heads recorded and reviewed for current source selection
runtime contract matches immutable app identity and declares the greenfield visible UI probe
